decision: M2 Turn submission remains disabled until ProductTurnRuntime and the WorkspaceAgent alarm owner are wired; disabled admission returns 503 before resolving a WorkspaceAgent actor or persisting a queued turn.

checks.disabledValues: undefined, null, boolean false, false, TRUE and 1 all reject with turn_runtime_not_ready/503
checks.mutationFence: disabled submit resolves WorkspaceAgent zero times
checks.enabledForwarding: the explicit true value derives the scoped WorkspaceAgent and forwards one exact request
checks.trustedPiSnapshot: the host always supplies the verified input snapshot value, including explicit undefined, after release options

limitations: The gate is a local source and configuration candidate; the currently deployed Worker version is unchanged.
ProductTurnRuntime Durable Object binding, WorkspaceAgent engine wiring and product release policy remain incomplete.
The Trusted Pi image still lacks a real Docker or cloud VM build and execution record.
